capes.name: Apprentice’s Mantle
capes.lore: A plain grey mantle, sewn by someone who believed in you.

capes.name: Journeyman’s Mantle
capes.lore: Stitched with the small marks of every trade you have tried.

capes.name: Cape of Coffin-Oak
capes.lore: Mastery of the axe. It smells faintly of sawdust and old promises.

capes.name: Cape of Grave-Iron
capes.lore: Mastery of the pick. Heavy, and cold to the touch.

capes.name: Cape of the Black Water
capes.lore: Mastery of the line. It is always a little damp.

capes.name: Cape of the Sexton
capes.lore: Mastery of the spade. The dead are quiet around it.

capes.name: Cape of the Mourning Bed
capes.lore: Mastery of the garden. Something is always growing on it.

capes.name: Cape of the Alembic
capes.lore: Mastery of the brew. It shifts colour when you are not looking.

capes.name: Cape of the Bone Grinder
capes.lore: Mastery of the grinder. Nothing is wasted, and nothing stays whole.

capes.name: The Sexton’s Mantle
capes.lore: Ninety-nine in every rite. The Covenant has no higher thanks to give.

pets.name: Tithe Bat
pets.lore: It roosts in the coffin-oaks and follows the sound of the axe.

pets.lore: Pulled from black water, still wet, still hopeful.
